capabilities: Sync notes and attachments to Baidu Netdisk incrementally
Preserve conflicting versions during folder-based sync
Pair devices with encrypted pairing codes
Encrypt file content with optional E2EE
extras: Requires creating your own Baidu developer application for AppKey/AppSecret; credentials and the E2EE password are stored in local plugin settings, not an OS keychain. E2EE protects file content, not all filenames or metadata. iOS/Android hardware validation is still outstanding and background suspension or app exit can interrupt transfers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through Baidu Netdisk while preserving conflicting versions.

relations.evidence: Folder-based Markdown conflict handling requires the separately installed QYY Folder Notes
an independently installed BRAT can install QYY542/qyy-baidu-sync
Network requests go to Baidu for OAuth, listings, uploads and downloads

requires.name: Baidu developer application AppKey and AppSecret

summary: Incremental sync plugin that syncs notes and attachments to Baidu Netdisk, preserving conflict versions and tracking pending changes.
